name: Apache Flink Open-Source Stream Processing
free_limit: Apache-2.0 distributed stream and batch processing engine for self-operated clusters, with no vendor software job-count or event-processing quota.
watch_out: Requires own Java runtime, cluster compute, memory, network, storage/checkpoints and operations. Cloud-managed Flink offerings and external message brokers/connectors may incur charges; not a hosted free stream-processing plan.
